name: Sound vs Tišina
genre: Balance Puzzle / Acoustic Simulator / Career Manager
description: Ti si promoter koji uči zanat — podesi zvuk tako da dance floor živi a susedi spavaju. SPL fizika, 8 terena, karijera od Šumskog Sata do Avala Open-Air.

modules.index.html: Entry point, full DOM structure for all 5 screens
modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap + game loop orchestrator, wires all systems
modules.src/config.js: All constants: grid dims, SPL thresholds, career titles, timing
modules.src/input.js: InputManager class: mouse + touch canvas handler
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: ambientBeat, complaintSound, happinessChord, warningBleep, gameOverDrone
modules.src/render.js: Canvas render loop orchestrator at 30 FPS
modules.src/systems/spl-engine.js: Core SPL physics: computeHeatmap, getNeighborSPL, computeAverageHappiness
modules.src/systems/venue.js: loadVenue: zones init, upgrade bonuses, budget
modules.src/systems/events.js: Dynamic events: seeded random spawn, tick aging, modifiers
modules.src/systems/progression.js: XP, career titles, level unlock, calculateSessionXP
modules.src/entities/zone.js: AudioZone class: pos, db slider, dot indicator
modules.src/render/heatmap.js: Offscreen canvas heatmap: per-cell SPL color, neighbor ring, 30 FPS
modules.src/render/terrain.js: Terrain floor plan: type-based colors, zone boundary overlays
modules.src/render/ui-elements.js: Canvas overlay: zone dots, pulsing main stage, HUD bar
modules.src/ui/hud.js: DOM HUD: time display, happiness bar, thermometer, complaint dots
modules.src/ui/sliders.js: DOM sliders per controllable zone: touch support, color feedback
modules.src/ui/game-over.js: Game over screen: stats, mentor quote, Avala CTA
modules.src/ui/venue-select.js: 8-card venue grid: unlock state, difficulty stars
modules.src/content/venues.js: All 8 venue configs per GDD table
modules.src/content/upgrades.js: 24 upgrade items with costs, bonuses, dependencies
modules.src/content/dialogue.js: Sava + Tonketa mentor lines, 5+ per category
modules.styles/base.css: Dark theme layout, button styles, responsive
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD, sliders, event feed, venue cards, upgrades grid, game over
modules.styles/game.css: Screen shake, canvas animations, event pulse, mobile adjustments
